Comments: A variant card called the Carte d'Immatriculation (immatriculation card) is issued to foreigners residing in Morocco for various statuses including visitors, students, workers, family reunification, and long-term healthcare. This is not the same as the full CNIE but provides a form of ID registration for some non-nationals. Not all non-nationals are eligible.
